class Solution:
    def zigzagTraversal(self, grid: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        res = []
        rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        take = True
        for r in range(rows):
            if r % 2 == 0:  # left to right
                cols_range = range(cols)
            else:  # right to left
                cols_range = range(cols - 1, -1, -1)
            for c in cols_range:
                if take:
                    res.append(grid[r][c])
                take = not take
        return res

class Solution:
    def zigzagTraversal(self, grid: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        result = []
        for i, row in enumerate(grid):
            if i % 2 == 0:  # left to right
                cols = range(len(row))
            else:          # right to left
                cols = range(len(row) - 1, -1, -1)
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                if j % 2 == 0:  # take every alternate cell
                    result.append(row[col])
        return result
